title: Standing Relief on Annual Prepay Renewals — Premium Billing Accounts
content:
**Relief.** On a Cascade Individual Annual Prepay account of Premium Billing Accounts, a standing relief is deducted from the renewal payment for a long-standing account with a clean return record. The relief is the last amount taken from the renewal payment before the total is floored at 0.00 and rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Clean return record.** The account's returned payments within 24 months before the payment date are no more than its returned payments within the whole calendar months from the renewal invoice's date to the payment date, plus one. Both counts are made the way a record counts as falling within a number of months before the payment date: the whole calendar months from its date to the payment date, counted the way an anniversary is counted (a month is complete only when a later month reaches the same day number, and the last day of a shorter month does not complete it), are fewer than that number. So a return in the days before the renewal invoice inside the same whole-month count counts with the latter.

**The fee concerned.** The returned-payment fee booked last is the fee booked last on the account (of two booked on the same day, the one recorded first); it counts as booked since the renewal invoice when its date is on or after that invoice's date. The renewal invoice is the invoice issued last (of two issued on the same day, the one recorded first).

**Tiers** (tenure: the whole calendar months from the account's opening date to the payment date)
| Clean return record | Tenure | Fee booked last counts as booked since the renewal invoice | Relief |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | 60 months or more | yes | that fee in full |
| yes | at least 36 but fewer than 60 months | yes | 50 percent of that fee |
| other combinations | | | none |

**Boundary points.** 35 months: none; 36: 50 percent; 59: 50 percent; 60: full.

**Hypothetical cases** (renewal invoice dated 17 August; payment date 19 October; the invoice count runs over 3 months).
- Opened 64 whole months before; one return on 9 September with a 25.00 fee that day; no other return within 24 months: relief 25.00.
- Same, opened 50 whole months before: 12.50.
- Same as the first, plus a return 14 months before the payment date: no relief.
